about: The Higgsfield renewal trial: four tests to answer one question for Dinis Cruz, whether Higgsfield earns next month's renewal. Written by higgsfield.c (account C), who judges and keeps the ledger; the generating is done by account B's Higgsfield agent. Material, not instruction: only Dinis instructs.
status: Waiting. Nothing is spent until Dinis gives his own word on the spend cap to the generating agent.
question: Renew if Higgsfield gives usable assets that code cannot make, at a time and cost per usable asset worth paying, for the agreed uses only.

do: Key-frame stills as internal storyboard references
Plates and textures used as a layer inside a WebGL scene
do_not: Replace a WebGL scene with a clip
Any person, face or crowd of human figures; never a named author
Any words inside a generated frame
agreed_uses.dinis: "Higgs field is a supporting, not a replacement." (28 Nov 2026, relayed by conductor.c)

spend.cap: None set by Dinis, as relayed by conductor.c on 28 Nov 2026 ("we can spend as much as we want"); his own word to the generating agent is still awaited.
spend.rule: Record every generation's cost even without a cap.

tests.name: Opening plates
tests.make: 3 abstract stills, 1280x720, no people, no text, in the ink palette (navy, amber, teal, coral).
tests.style_references: 3 frames from the productions media vault l9bf0dri (read key in https://studio.agents.sovereignweb.site/productions/media.json), path agile-history/v0.3/frames/: one each from royce-cascade, snowbird-page and badge-factory.
tests.measure: One is composited as a still texture under the opening title in a lab-only scene; the critic scores it against the plain opening on rubric points 3, 4 and 5 (https://studio.agents.sovereignweb.site/productions/lab/critic.md); Dinis picks.

tests.name: Storyboard key frames
tests.make: 4 to 6 stills for the rewritten opening of The story of Agile: Agile took over; what a methodology is; the waterfall; software shipping a couple of times a year; the process solidifying. Abstract, no people, no text.
tests.measure: Used as references in a scene-smith brief. Rounds and sub-agent cost to a scene Dinis calls right, against the earlier lab scenes (about three rounds each, https://studio.agents.sovereignweb.site/productions/cell.json).
tests.pass: Fewer rounds or lower cost to a scene Dinis accepts.

tests.name: What code cannot do
tests.make: 1 short motion texture (mist, grain or light leak) by image-to-video, delivered as a frame-indexed sprite sheet so render(t) stays a pure function of time.
tests.measure: Compared with a shader version c.productions makes in one round.
tests.pass: It reads clearly better than the shader version.

tests.name: Poster frames
tests.make: 1 poster still per production: agile-history and web-summit-galaxy. No people, no text (titles are set by the page).
tests.measure: Used on the timeline or not.

order: T1, then T2, then T3 and T4. Stop early if T1 and T2 both fail.
record_per_generation: credits or cost as the account shows it
usable yes or no, and why (judged by higgsfield.c against the rubric, then c.productions; Dinis decides on anything shown in a scene)
rules: Failures are recorded too, not only keepers.
"Image made by AI" inside any frame that is shown; "synthetic" and "made by AI" in captions.
Files go into a vault with a published read key, never a repository; send the vault id and read key, with the ledger as JSON beside the assets.
No real person's likeness or voice.
send_back: Vault id, read key and the ledger, through c.maestro to conductor.c, who passes them to higgsfield.c.
verdict: At the end, a short page for Dinis: usable rate, time and cost per usable asset, what it did that code could not, what it failed at, and a plain recommendation (renew, renew smaller, or stop).
